messages:
rachel: quick one - noticed the ruby sampleapp CI failing on our PR with a flaky bundler network error. anyone seen this pop up lately?
tim: yeah intermittent on GH mac runners. usually `bundle install` times out fetching a gem from rubygems.org. retry fixed it locally.
rachel: curious if we should vendor the tiny test dependency or pin a mirror for CI to reduce flakes.
tim: vendor small dev-only gem is fine. also add `bundle config retry 3` in CI before install.
ci-bot: opened devex PR #2207 to add bundler retry + vendor deps for CI stability.
rachel: added note to PR about keeping vendor dir small and excluded from release packaging. thanks!
